text: Using birth control such as the pill or an IUD makes it harder for most women to get pregnant once they stop.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: Using birth control such as the pill or IUDs makes it harder for most women to get pregnant once they stop using them
room.note: 5% definitely true, 29% probably true, 46% probably false, 18% definitely false.

truthSource.label: ACOG, Combined hormonal birth control
truthSource.oneLine: Fertility returns promptly after stopping the pill or removing an IUD; there is no lasting reduction in the ability to conceive.

lesson.tip: A friend’s story travels faster than a study. Fertility questions are settled by large studies summarized by medical bodies.
